name: Chanty
description: Chanty is a team communication and collaboration service with conversations, messages, tasks, calls, files, a Teambook, and prebuilt integrations.
agentUseSummary: Chanty cannot currently be connected because its public integration directory provides prebuilt apps and directs custom integration requests to Chanty, while its Enterprise API is a contact-sales feature. Chanty publishes no multi-tenant delegated OAuth registration, scopes, token lifecycle, revocation, API schema, or webhook contract sufficient for a Relay provider.

blocked.label: Connect a Chanty account
blocked.description: Chanty does not publicly document a developer-app registration and delegated consent, refresh, and revocation lifecycle for a multi-tenant Relay integration.

blocked.label: Use the Enterprise API
blocked.description: Enterprise API is a contact-sales feature whose official schema, credentials, effective authority, commercial terms, and multi-tenant authorization are not publicly available.

blocked.label: Use unofficial access
blocked.description: Third-party tutorials, reverse-engineered clients, guessed bearer tokens, and undocumented endpoints cannot define Relay's provider contract.

blocked.label: Access Chanty data
blocked.description: Teams, members, conversations, messages, calls, files, tasks, Teambook, integrations, exports, administration, and every read or write remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without an official provider contract and a product decision accepting its credential and authority model.

runtimeSupport.description: Chanty has no public provider contract that Relay can safely mount as OpenClaw tools.
Chanty has no public provider contract that Relay can safely mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Chanty's public surface provides prebuilt integrations and a sales-gated Enterprise API but no documented public delegated OAuth/API trust boundary, lifecycle, schemas, or multi-tenant terms.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only after Chanty supplies official Enterprise API documentation and written multi-tenant authorization, followed by a product/security decision for the offered credential model.

evidence.supports: Chanty's public directory lists prebuilt integrations and asks customers to contact Chanty to request another app rather than documenting public developer registration or OAuth.
Chanty lists Enterprise API only under its contact-sales Enterprise tier alongside custom and managed deployment features.
Chanty publishes product security information but not the developer authorization, token, webhook, schema, and revocation contract needed for Relay.
